subject: Mid-cycle OKR decision log, scope trims, and dependency buckets
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mid-cycle OKR decision log, scope trims, and dependency buckets

Team —

Quick mid-cycle note ahead of QBR prep tomorrow. I pulled a light decision log from the tracker and flagged the places we need explicit owner commits to avoid scope creep. TL;DR: two rescope proposals (infra & evals), three dependency buckets that need committed delivery dates, and one ask for a short resource trade to keep latency SLO work on track.

Status highlights (numbers pulled from tracker):
- Serving throughput OKR (Latency P50 < 120ms): 66% complete vs. plan; major blocker is shared KV cache rollout on dedicated nodes.
- Cost-intel OKR (unit cost -15%): 42% complete; batching gains are on-track but model quantization trials lag (blocked by infra image QA).
- Adoption OKR (internal apps onboarded): 78% complete; two pilot partners (ApexHealth) need readiness confirmation.

Proposals for scope trims (recommendations):
1) Infra: Delay non-critical dashboard feature (per-route cost breakdown UI) by one sprint; keep backend metrics collection.
2) Evals: Narrow the regression test set to top 50 prompts for the roll forward; run full set as post-rollout smoke.

Dependency buckets (please add owner + committed date):
- DB / KV cache rollout (blocking Latency OKR) — owner suggestion: Karthik — need committed date by EOD Tue.
- Infra image QA for quantized models (blocking Cost OKR) — owner suggestion: Markus — need committed date by Wed.
- ApexHealth prod readiness (blocking Adoption OKR) — owner: Vanessa to coordinate with procurement — need pilot go/no-go by Fri.

Asks:
- Karthik: can your team commit to a rollout window (2-day maintenance) this week? If not, propose alternative mitigation (canary on dedicated pool?).
- Markus: what’s the earliest we can get a signed QA slot for the quantized image? 48–72h would be ideal.
- Vanessa: please confirm ApexHealth procurement dependencies (PO, IP addendum). I copied their contact below so we can short-circuit.

Attachments: OKR-tracker-2026Q4.xlsx (highlighted rows), dependency-buckets.csv. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBq-okrs-q4

I’ll synthesize replies into the QBR pre-read at 3pm PT and circulate the decision log. If we can lock the three dates, we avoid a full replan.

Thanks —
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Head of Product Ops | Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle OKR decision log, scope trims, and dependency buckets

Thanks Dylan — quick clarifying Qs:
- For the infra trim (dashboard UI), are there promised deliverables to PMs that we need to re-announce? I want to avoid surprise misalignment with Console PM.
- For ApexHealth, do we already have draft IP terms or is that in legal review? If legal still needs the draft, Vanessa, can you loop them in?

I’m OK with the narrowed eval set as long as we preserve rollback criteria in the plan. I’ll be in the QBR pre-read sync at 3pm.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Data Platform | Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 11:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle OKR decision log, scope trims, and dependency buckets

Copying in plan here. Short answers:
- Quantized image QA: we have one wrapped slot on Tue morning and a second on Thu afternoon; Tue is the earliest sign-off path if infra can provide the test harness by Monday EOD. If they can’t, we need to push the QA window by one week.
- Dashboard trim: low risk — Console PM confirmed they can shift the UI slice; backend telemetry remains prioritized. Laura, we should send a short note to Console PM this afternoon.

Longer note: we can free a single engineer for a 3-day focused effort to deflake the KV rollout if leadership approves a short-term shift (I estimate 40% impact on their other sprint). That would get us to a canary by Thu. If leadership declines, we fall back to a staggered canary (longer runway).

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Serving Infra | Redwood Inference

- IP addendum: do you have a standard SOC/IPA form or do you need our legal team to send a template?
